sources.title: KIA - K500&K506 - 070126.pdf
sources.read_as: Text layer, header of every page. This is Drive's NEWEST Kia bulletin and it is already expired.

changes.new: Incentive rates below are from bulletins 2026-036/037 — contracts had to be dated by March 31, 2026 and funded by April 14. They are four months dead. Drive's newest bulletin (2026-091) has also expired: contracts July 7 – August 3, funding deadline August 17. There is no current Kia bulletin on file. Do not quote these rates — get the live bulletin from KFA.
changes.quote: Effective with Contracts Dated July 7, 2026 - August 3, 2026 | Contract & Documentation Package must be Received & Funded by August 17, 2026
changes.note: Document age cannot express this. The Kia record's effectiveDate reads 'K500/K506 July 7, 2026', which is 50 days old and would badge green — but the rates stored in the incentives section are from March, and even the newest bulletin in Drive expired on August 17. A freshness check that reads only dates would wave the store's own captive through while it shows April money. This is the one case the date-based badge would get wrong, so it is stated explicitly.

ambiguities.note: This warning must be deleted the moment a current bulletin is loaded and the incentives section is re-extracted. `sync.py freshness` preserves an existing warning rather than recomputing it, so nothing will clear it automatically — that is deliberate, but it means it can outlive its truth if nobody removes it.
